slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does one training jet produce per year — is it a fixed number of pilots per training jet, and does a jet used for training in year 1 also produce pilots again in year 2, or is each training jet used for only one year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the per-year pilot production of one training jet, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarify the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: does a jet used for training in year 1 also produce pilots again in year 2, or is each training jet used for only one year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched on the multi-year training timeline by asking whether year 1 training jets also produce in year 2, but did not explicitly ask when training starts or how many years the training program lasts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in year 1 and lasts for 2 years, with year 1 training jets active in both years and year 2 training jets active only in year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not explicitly confirm the start year or duration of the training program; it inferred the timeline from questions about carryover and production years.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 training duration/start slot was only partially resolved and not explicitly confirmed.

summary: The agent recovered the critical P0 training capacity and clarified many operational details, but stopped with the P1 training timeline only partially resolved and silently assumed the start year and duration.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
